messages: hannah: Heads-up — I'm about to open a stack of ~6 docs PRs that move a bunch of reference pages into `reference/` and create redirects. Need a quick plan so we don't merge in a way that breaks anchors or the site nav. michelle: +1 on planning. Can you list which pages and which will have anchor changes? hannah: Short list in the PR desc but gist: api/auth.md -> reference/authentication.md (anchors change for `#token-rotation` etc). sdk/js/usage.md -> reference/sdk-js.md (examples moved), and a big rename of `deploy/README.md` -> `deploy/overview.md` (anchors used by 3 other pages). tom: For multi-PR moves I'd prefer staggered merges: 1) create redirect PRs (no content changes) 2) update internal links and examples in dependent pages 3) merge source-to-target move. Keeps previews stable. akshat: We should also pin the order in the PR titles like "move: auth (step 1/3)" so reviewers know sequencing. CI will run previews for each PR — we can verify no 404s for the docs preview URLs. jen: Who's reviewing each? I can take authentication and SDK JS examples (has tests). Marco can do deploy/README. marco: Yep I can do deploy and the cross-links. Will need a preview link to confirm anchors in the nav. cory: Two quick safety rules I've used before: add a lightweight smoke test that curls the preview and greps for a few anchors, and use the redirect rules in the redirect config (not hard-coded HTML pages). Example redirect snippet:```yaml - from: /api/auth to: /reference/authentication status: 301 ``` hannah: Good idea — I'll add smoke checks as a workflow that runs on PRs labelled `docs/move`. It will fetch the docs preview URL from netlify/preview-bot output. michelle: About anchors: when you move and rename heading text, anchors change. Prefer to keep heading text stable, or add explicit HTML anchors to keep backward compat. Eg add "" above the section. akshat: Or use MkDocs `toc` plugin? But explicit anchors are safest short-term. Also we should update any code snippets in SDK repo that reference old paths — do a repo grep for `/deploy/README.md` and add a TODO in those PRs. hannah: I've created the first PR: 1918201240-move-auth-redirects (redirect-only). Preview link posted in the PR. Asking for review from @michelle and @jen. docs-bot: Preview generated: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/1918201240 — 200 OK, but check anchor checks. jen: Looking. Quick pass: redirect 301 is fine, preview HTML shows heading `Token rotation` with id `token-rotation` present. :thumbsup: marco: For deploy rename I'll add an anchor shim to preserve `#deploy-process` — I'll include both H2 and explicit anchor. cory: Sequence proposal: (A) merge redirect-only PRs first, (B) merge content moves one-by-one with reviewers assigned, (C) run a sweep PR to fix internal links and examples across docs. That minimizes live breakage. tom: Agree. Also add a Canary label to the first content move so platform folks know to watch routing. We should hold off auto-deploy to prod for 15 minutes after merge for quick rollback window. Ops can help if we need a revert. hannah: Ops notified. I'll add the `no-auto-prod` label to these PRs. Also adding a checklist in each PR: redirect exists, preview smoke checks pass, list of dependent pages updated in PR body. michelle: Small nit — when updating examples in SDK snippets, keep the old example in a short comment so external users copying code don't immediately break. Then remove after one release cycle. akshat: Who is the final approver? For a large refactor we need at least 2 reviewers including one from devx. Jen + Michelle works. jen: Taking auth + SDK js review. I'll mark approved once smoke tests pass. marco: I'll take deploy rename review. hannah: Timeline: I'll open the rest of the redirect PRs today (4 more), then content move PRs tomorrow morning in a staggered order. Aim to have everything merged by EOD Friday if no blockers. cory: Add a post-merge job that runs a site-wide link checker and posts results in this thread. We can catch stray 404s. docs-bot: Link-check job scheduled: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/link-check/1918201234 — results will post on completion. tom: If the link-check finds broken anchors, let's prefer patch PRs that add explicit anchor shims over reverting moves. Reverts are last resort. hannah: Sounds good. I'll tag this thread in each PR body and update here as merges happen. Thanks all :) michelle: Thanks — ping when first move is merged so I can scan related pages. jen: Approved 1918201240 (redirect-only). Smoke checks green. hannah: Merged 1918201240 — redirect in place. Opening move PR for auth next: 1918201300-move-auth-content. cory: Link-check finished: 0 broken links detected in preview environment for the redirect-only PR. hannah: Adding `ready for review` on the auth content move. marco: Noted, will review after lunch. akshat: One reminder: update the docs changelog with the renames so external users searching for old slugs can find the new ones. hannah: Will do. I'll post a short migration note in /docs/changes/ and in the PR descriptions. jen: Great coordination — this sequencing should keep the site stable. :rocket:
